answer: Before a new agent can trade, it must present three attestations from separate oracles, each checking a different real-world signal, a phone number, a payment account, and a device certificate, all bound to one public key. A panel checks the three match the same key through a prism of separate proofs within a seven-day horizon. A mismatch or duplicate means rejection and a ban for good. One honest agent passes three checks once, for free, yet a thousand fakes would need three thousand distinct real-world accounts, and that nectar cannot be gathered overnight.
